game.title: Mass Effect: Andromeda
game.blurb: Science-fiction action RPG set in the Andromeda galaxy, from BioWare, released 2017-03-21. RAWG average playtime: 23 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Becoming the Pathfinder, the Tempest, Aya and the angara, Remnant vaults, the exaltation facility and Meridian.

chapters.title: Arks, Allies and Squadmates
chapters.summary: The other arks and the krogan colony ship, the outlaws, the Roekaar, uniting the outposts, squadmate tasks and romances.

chapters.title: Exploring Planets
chapters.summary: Outposts, planet viability, the Nomad, scanning and Remnant puzzles.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Power combos, melee, hovering, constructs, revives and Remnant tricks.

chapters.title: Levels, Profiles and Crafting
chapters.summary: Levels, weapon ranks, profiles, evolving powers and crafting.

chapters.title: APEX Multiplayer and Strike Teams
chapters.summary: The multiplayer mode, strike team missions, extractions and Insanity runs.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Mass Effect: Andromeda" or "Mass Effect Andromeda". masseffect.fandom.com answers the API under "Mass Effect: Andromeda", with about 121 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 55 Steam achievements is hidden, so story beats are visible and the main story chapter is built from them. "Unwavering" (Insanity single-player or Gold multiplayer extractions) and "APEX" (the multiplayer tutorial) were put in the APEX chapter. Which story achievements are main path and which are optional (the arks, the krogan colony ship, the Roekaar leader) is a guess from the descriptions and needs checking.
